nodes.text: coder 0 (office-report-builder 0): The sole spreadsheet writer creates both `satisfaction_analysis.xlsx` and `action_plans.xlsx`. The analysis workbook contains substantive `Summary Metrics`, `Product or Dimension`, and `Customer Segment` sheets with literal numeric cells and explicit unavailable dimensions. The action plan uses exact columns `Initiative, Owner, Target Metric, Baseline, Goal, Timeline, Status` with at least five evidence-linked rows. Read every populated range back.

coder 1 (office-report-builder 1): The sole document writer creates both `satisfaction_report.docx` and the distinct `executive_summary.docx`, each at least 60 words and covering the task-required metrics, evidence-backed findings, business implications, and prioritized actions. Read both full texts back.

coder 2 (external-workflow-operator 0): The sole dashboard writer searches the exact cloud-spreadsheet title, reuses one exact match or creates once on zero, blocks duplicates, writes summary, product/dimension, segment, and monitoring views from the canonical JSON, and reads its sheet inventory and bounded ranges back.
